subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox adopt this dedicated SSM-only AWS workspace service and its fail-closed deployment boundary after the documented live AWS canary succeeds?
rationale: Tests and static template checks cannot establish that the intended account, IAM roles, subnet routes, security groups, task identity, SSM path, authentication boundary, and cleanup behavior work safely together in the target environment.

options.title: Require the live canary
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted target-account evidence demonstrates fail-closed startup, create, ready/status, SSM and posture evidence, and idempotent repeated deletion.

options.title: Decline or split the service
options.body: Close or redesign the work if maintainers do not want a dedicated route-scoped AWS workspace deployment and operational contract in Crabbox core.

recommendation.title: Require the live canary
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted target-account evidence demonstrates fail-closed startup, create, ready/status, SSM and posture evidence, and idempotent repeated deletion.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the strongest ownership across the AWS, fleet, Node runtime, and adjacent security paths affected by this decision.
